name: prompt-optimizer
description: Turn long prompts into clear execution briefs without losing requirements or widening scope.

interface.longDescription: Use this when a request contains more than three relevant sentences or when you explicitly ask to optimize it. Prompt Optimizer returns a clear execution brief, preserves requirements and approval limits, and flags assumptions or unresolved decisions. Do not use it to execute the request; it keeps explicit no-rewrite requests unchanged and cannot guarantee host selection or better output.
capabilities: Activate on four or more relevant sentences
defaultPrompt: Plan our API launch. Keep costs under $5,000. Do not publish anything. Return milestones, owners, risks, and approvals…
